Thanks for the sample data Tom.

Both of the samples you sent were tab delimited. The error you are
getting (for the public record) is:

Error in levels(crs$testset[[c]]) <<- c(levels(crs$testset[[c]]),
setdiff(levels(crs$dataset[[c]]), :
attempt to set an attribute on NULL

Whilst Rattle can read a txt file in the Data tab I've not coded up
the Evalute tab to deal with txt files. I think this error is coming
from loading up data when it expects a comma separated file. It loaded
up just fine when I changed the tabs to commas.

Are you able to change to CSV format, perhaps by saving as CSV from a
spreadsheet application?

(I'll also note to fix this problem, probably by loading txt if that
is how the trianing data has been loaded).

Let me know how you go.

Thank you also for your kind words about Rattle.

Regards,
